'''Wakamiya-sha''' (若宮社) refers to Shinto shrines across Japan. Some are distinguished by additional place names.

* {{ill|Iwashimizu Hachimangū|en|Iwashimizu Hachimangū|qid=Q710098|lt=Iwashimizu Hachiman Shrine|1=Iwashimizu Hachimangū}} subsidiary shrine - Kyoto Prefecture, Yawata City; shrine building designated as an Important Cultural Property.
* {{ill|Yoshida Shrine|en|Yoshida Shrine|qid=Q713177|lt=Yoshida Shrine|1=Yoshida Shrine}} subsidiary shrine - Kyoto Prefecture, Kyoto City, Sakyo Ward.
* {{ill|Ōmiwa Shrine|en|Ōmiwa Shrine|qid=Q705542|lt=Ōmiwa Shrine|1=Ōmiwa Shrine}} subsidiary shrine; another name for {{ill|Ōtataneko Shrine|ja|大直禰子神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtataneko Shrine|qq=}} - Nara Prefecture, Sakurai City.
* {{ill|Hiro Hachiman Shrine|en|Hiro Hachiman Shrine|qid=Q391335|lt=Hiro Hachiman Shrine|1=Hiro Hachiman Shrine}} subsidiary shrine - Wakayama Prefecture, Hirogawa Town; shrine building designated as an Important Cultural Property.
* {{ill|Wakamiya-sha (Gosen)|ja|若宮社（五泉市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wakamiya-sha (Gosen)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Niigata Prefecture, Gosen City.
* {{ill|Suzumemori Wakamiya-sha|ja|雀森若宮社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suzumemori Wakamiya-sha|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Niigata Prefecture, Tsubame City.
* {{ill|Wakamiya-sha (Okazaki)|ja|若宮社 (岡崎市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wakamiya-sha (Okazaki)|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 額田地区|1=Q17214124|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q17214124}} - Aichi Prefecture, Okazaki City.
* {{ill|Hakusan Shrine (Heguri)|ja|白山神社 (平群町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hakusan Shrine (Heguri)|qq=}} subsidiary shrine - Nara Prefecture, Heguri Town.
* {{ill|Chinjyu Wakamiya-sha|ja|鎮守若宮社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chinjyu Wakamiya-sha|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Ehime Prefecture, Matsuyama City.
* {{ill|Wakamiya-sha (Saga)|ja|若宮社 (佐賀市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wakamiya-sha (Saga)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Saga Prefecture, Saga City.
* {{ill|Wakamiya-sha (Usa)|ja|若宮社 (宇佐市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wakamiya-sha (Usa)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Ōita Prefecture, Usa City.
